title: Larry Shields and other trombonists
summary: Brief remarks on Shields, Schilling and trombonists on the coast.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Larry Shields. Wonderful. His brother plays good too down the road. This person was just here. They think that there's nobody like the Shields playing on it now with Chalky. Yeah, Harry is. She said she never liked Clarence, but she liked him.
Yeah, very good. Any other trombone players? How did Happy Schilling play? He's retired now. I talked to him.

Well, he played mostly valve trombone. Mostly valve, huh. And uh, Esteudian Lane played pretty good. He died. And uh, well as a guy on the coast I liked, Joe Uckel and Abe Lincoln. Oh yeah. Yeah. But Abe tries to do the impossible. He plays high trumpet trombone. Yeah, he's up there awfully high. Yeah. Trombone isn't made for that.
